title: Mastery
blurb: Deep track: all 12 workbenches plus Easy, Medium, and Hard coding practice spanning all 18 DSA topics.

steps.title: Arrays: indexed storage
steps.summary: Arrays store items contiguously for O(1) indexing; a middle insert shifts the whole tail.

steps.title: Sorting basics
steps.summary: Sorting puts data in order so binary search and two-pointer scans work; watch the comparisons.

steps.title: Binary search step-through
steps.summary: On sorted data each probe halves the range, so any item is found in O(log n).

steps.title: Singly linked list
steps.summary: Nodes linked by pointers: O(1) inserts at a known spot, O(n) access by position.

steps.title: LIFO stack
steps.summary: Last-in first-out: O(1) push and pop, the engine behind bracket matching and undo.

steps.title: FIFO queue
steps.summary: First-in first-out: enqueue at the back, dequeue at the front, the base of BFS.

steps.title: Tree traversals
steps.summary: Inorder, preorder, and postorder each visit every node once in a different order.

steps.title: Binary search tree
steps.summary: Left subtree smaller, right subtree larger: search, insert, and delete follow the ordering.

steps.title: Binary heap
steps.summary: A complete tree kept in array form: the root holds the min or max, sift to repair.

steps.title: Hash map buckets
steps.summary: Keys hash into buckets for average O(1) lookups; collisions chain inside a bucket.

steps.title: Graph traversal
steps.summary: BFS explores by distance, DFS by depth; both mark nodes so nothing is revisited.

steps.title: Recursion tree
steps.summary: Draw every call as a node to see the branching that sets the time complexity.

steps.title: Two Sum
steps.summary: Store each value's index in a hash map and look up the complement in one pass.

steps.title: Contains Duplicate
steps.summary: Insert each value into a set; a failed insert means a duplicate.

steps.title: Valid Anagram
steps.summary: Compare character counts, or sort both strings and compare them.

steps.title: Product of Array Except Self
steps.summary: Prefix products left to right, then suffix products right to left, multiplied in place.

steps.title: Group Anagrams
steps.summary: Sort each word or count its letters to build a canonical key for a hash map.

steps.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
steps.summary: Prefix sums in a hash map: count earlier prefixes equal to the current sum minus k.

steps.title: Top K Frequent Elements
steps.summary: Count with a hash map, then bucket by frequency or keep a size-k heap.

steps.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
steps.summary: Put values in a set and grow runs upward only from numbers with no predecessor.

steps.title: Set Matrix Zeroes
steps.summary: Flag rows and columns in the first row and column, then apply the zeroing.

steps.title: First Missing Positive
steps.summary: Index placement: move each value 1..n into its own slot, then scan for the gap.

steps.title: Max Points on a Line
steps.summary: For each anchor, group slopes in a hash map using reduced fractions.

steps.title: Rotate Array
steps.summary: Reverse the whole array, then reverse each of the two parts.

steps.title: Valid Palindrome
steps.summary: Two pointers skip non-alphanumerics and compare characters inward.

steps.title: Three Sum
steps.summary: Sort, then anchor each value and close in with two pointers; skip repeats to keep triples unique.

steps.title: Container With Most Water
steps.summary: Two pointers at the ends: move the shorter wall inward, tracking the best area.

steps.title: Trapping Rain Water
steps.summary: Water above a bar is the smaller of the two side maxima minus the bar's own height.

steps.title: Boats to Save People
steps.summary: Sort, then pair the heaviest person with the lightest one that still fits.

steps.title: Palindromic Substrings
steps.summary: Expand around every centre, counting each successful expansion.

steps.title: 4Sum
steps.summary: Two nested anchors plus a two-pointer tail on sorted values, with dedup at every level.

steps.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
steps.summary: Window plus a last-seen index map: jump the left edge past the previous duplicate.

steps.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
steps.summary: Window with a letter count: shrink while length minus the top count exceeds k.

steps.title: Find All Anagram Windows
steps.summary: Fixed-size window with a 26-slot count compared against the pattern.

steps.title: Smallest Window Covering a Multiset
steps.summary: Expand until every needed character is covered, then contract to the smallest window.

steps.title: Sliding Window Maximum
steps.summary: Monotonic deque of indices, dropping values smaller than the incoming one.

steps.title: Subarrays with K Different Integers
steps.summary: At-most-k minus at-most-(k-1) counting with a window and a frequency map.

steps.title: Valid Parentheses
steps.summary: Push openers on a stack and require every closer to match the current top.

steps.title: Min Stack
steps.summary: Auxiliary stack of running minima so every top and min query stays O(1).

steps.title: Waiting for Warmer Days
steps.summary: Monotonic stack of indices waiting for a warmer day; pop and record the gaps.

steps.title: Decode String
steps.summary: Stack the repeat counts and partial strings, then expand on each closing bracket.

steps.title: Widest Bar Rectangle
steps.summary: Monotonic stack of bar indices; pop to measure each bar's widest span.

steps.title: Basic Calculator
steps.summary: Sign stack: push a pending sign, then fold a bracketed sub-expression on each closer.

steps.title: Remove K Digits
steps.summary: Monotonic stack: pop larger digits while removals remain, then trim the tail.

steps.title: Reverse Linked List
steps.summary: Walk the list once, pointing each node back at its predecessor.

steps.title: Linked List Cycle
steps.summary: Fast and slow pointers meet inside a cycle; no meeting means the list ends.

steps.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
steps.summary: Iterative splice with a dummy head, always attaching the smaller current node.

steps.title: Add Two Numbers
steps.summary: Walk both digit lists at once, carrying the overflow into a new tail node.

steps.title: Reorder List
steps.summary: Find the middle, reverse the second half, then interleave the two halves.

steps.title: Merge k Sorted Lists
steps.summary: Min-heap of list heads, or pairwise merging, keeps order in O(n log k).

steps.title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
steps.summary: Reverse each k-sized block, then stitch blocks through the saved boundary nodes.

steps.title: Binary Search
steps.summary: Halve the range each step, keeping the invariant that the target lies inside it.

steps.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
steps.summary: Binary search that first decides which half of the rotation is sorted.

steps.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
steps.summary: Binary search comparing the midpoint with the right edge to locate the rotation point.

steps.title: Koko Eating Bananas
steps.summary: Binary search the eating speed; the hours needed is a monotone feasibility check.

steps.title: Split Array Largest Sum
steps.summary: Binary search the largest allowed sum, with a greedy split as the feasibility test.

steps.title: Median of Two Arrays
steps.summary: Binary search a partition of the shorter array so both halves balance.

steps.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
steps.summary: Postorder: one plus the deeper of the two child heights.

steps.title: Invert Binary Tree
steps.summary: Swap each node's children, then recurse into both subtrees.

steps.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
steps.summary: Carry open bounds down the recursion, or check that an inorder walk is sorted.

steps.title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
steps.summary: Inorder traversal visits BST values ascending; stop at the k-th visit.

steps.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
steps.summary: Postorder search: the node with both targets in different branches is the LCA.

steps.title: Level Order Listing
steps.summary: Queue-based BFS: drain one level per iteration before pushing the next.

steps.title: Best Downward Chain
steps.summary: Postorder gain clamping: pass up the better child branch, record the two-branch total.

steps.title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
steps.summary: Encode with preorder plus null markers, then rebuild by consuming the same stream.

steps.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
steps.summary: Min-heap of size k, or quickselect for average linear time.

steps.title: K Closest Points to the Origin
steps.summary: Max-heap of size k by squared distance, or a quickselect partition.

steps.title: Task Scheduler
steps.summary: Count frequencies, lay out the most common task with idle gaps, then take the max.

steps.title: Find Median from Data Stream
steps.summary: Two heaps, max for the lower half and min for the upper, rebalanced to stay within one.

steps.title: Subsets
steps.summary: Backtrack over include and exclude decisions for each element.

steps.title: Permutations
steps.summary: Backtrack with a used set, or swap values in place at each depth.

steps.title: Combination Sum
steps.summary: Backtrack over candidates, allowing reuse by recursing from the same index.

steps.title: Word Search
steps.summary: DFS from each cell, marking visited letters and unmarking them on backtrack.

steps.title: N-Queens Placements
steps.summary: Backtrack row by row, rejecting columns and diagonals already in use.

steps.title: Number of Islands
steps.summary: BFS or DFS flood each land cell and count the components.

steps.title: Rotting Oranges
steps.summary: Multi-source BFS from every rotten orange; the last level reached is the elapsed time.

steps.title: Course Schedule (Cycle Detection)
steps.summary: Detect a cycle in the prerequisite graph with DFS colours or Kahn's topological sort.

steps.title: Course Schedule II
steps.summary: Topological order via an indegree queue; a short output means the graph has a cycle.

steps.title: Clone Graph
steps.summary: Hash map from original node to clone, then DFS or BFS to copy every neighbour.

steps.title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
steps.summary: Reverse BFS from both ocean borders; cells reached twice are the answer.

steps.title: Word Ladder
steps.summary: BFS over one-letter mutations; the first time the target appears is the shortest chain.

steps.title: Accounts Merge
steps.summary: Union-find or BFS over an email graph: one account per connected component.

steps.title: Alien Dictionary
steps.summary: Build edges from adjacent characters, then topologically sort to read the letter order.

steps.title: Climbing Stairs
steps.summary: Each step count is the sum of the two previous counts; iterate with two variables.

steps.title: House Robber
steps.summary: DP over houses: take the current plus two-back, or skip to the previous best.

steps.title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane)
steps.summary: Kadane: keep the best sum ending here, restarting whenever it turns negative.

steps.title: Coin Change (Minimum Coins)
steps.summary: Bottom-up DP over amounts; each coin relaxes every reachable amount above it.

steps.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
steps.summary: Patience sorting: binary search where each value lands in the tails array.

steps.title: Unique Paths in Grid
steps.summary: Grid DP where each cell sums the paths from above and from the left.

steps.title: Word Break
steps.summary: DP over prefixes: a cut is valid if the tail is a dictionary word and its prefix is reachable.

steps.title: Edit Distance
steps.summary: Grid DP over prefixes with insert, delete, and replace costs.

steps.title: Burst Balloons
steps.summary: Interval DP: choose which balloon bursts last in each range and split the problem.

steps.title: Gas Station
steps.summary: Single pass: reset the start whenever the running fuel total goes negative.

steps.title: Jump Game II
steps.summary: BFS by levels over jump ranges, counting the jumps needed to reach the end.

steps.title: Candy
steps.summary: Two passes over the ratings, left to right then right to left, keeping the larger need.

steps.title: Maximum Number of Events That Can Be Attended
steps.summary: Sort by end time and take every event starting after the last attended end.

steps.title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
steps.summary: Nested node maps per character, with a terminal flag at the end of each word.

steps.title: Search Suggestions System
steps.summary: Sort the products, then narrow a prefix range with binary search per query.

steps.title: Word Search II
steps.summary: Trie plus grid DFS prunes the search to prefixes that actually exist.

steps.title: Merge Intervals
steps.summary: Sort by start, then extend the current interval whenever the next one overlaps.

steps.title: Insert Interval
steps.summary: Copy intervals ending before the new one, merge all overlaps, then append the rest.

steps.title: Meeting Rooms II
steps.summary: Sort start and end times separately, then sweep counting overlapping meetings.

steps.title: Spiral Matrix
steps.summary: Peel the matrix with four shrinking boundaries: top, right, bottom, left.

steps.title: Rotate Image
steps.summary: Transpose across the main diagonal, then mirror every row horizontally.

steps.title: Pow(x, n)
steps.summary: Exponentiation by squaring: halve the exponent and square the base.

steps.title: Multiply Strings
steps.summary: Grade-school digit multiplication into a result array, then normalise the carries.

steps.title: Count Primes Below a Bound
steps.summary: Sieve of Eratosthenes: mark multiples of each prime up to the square root.

steps.title: Single Number
steps.summary: XOR every value: the pairs cancel and the unique number survives.

steps.title: Number of 1 Bits
steps.summary: Clear the lowest set bit with n & (n - 1) until the value reaches zero.

steps.title: Counting Bits
steps.summary: DP on bits: count(i) equals count(i >> 1) plus the lowest bit.

steps.title: Sort an Array
steps.summary: Implement merge sort or heap sort and respect the O(n log n) bound.

steps.title: Largest Number
steps.summary: Sort with a comparator that puts the larger concatenation first.

steps.title: LRU Cache
steps.summary: Hash map plus doubly linked list: move each hit to the front and evict the tail.

steps.title: Design Circular Queue
steps.summary: Fixed buffer with head, tail, and count, advancing every index modulo capacity.

steps.title: All O`one Data Structure
steps.summary: Bucket hash maps plus a linked list keep increment, decrement, and min/max at O(1).

steps.title: Arrays & hashing check
steps.summary: Frequency maps, indexing, and prefix sums under time pressure.

steps.title: Trees & BST check
steps.summary: Traversals, BST ordering, and height-based recursions.

steps.title: Graphs check
steps.summary: BFS, DFS, topological order, and connectivity questions.

steps.title: DP check
steps.summary: Recurrence choices, state design, and tabulation order.

steps.title: Aptitude screen
steps.summary: Quant, logical reasoning, and verbal questions in screening style.

steps.title: CS fundamentals screen
steps.summary: OS, DBMS, networks, and memory questions asked in service rounds.

steps.title: Final mock assessment
steps.summary: Timed mixed set across the whole bank, to test exam pacing.
